proof_body:
by
  intro a b c k ha
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, h, hp, hq⟩
    have h0 := h 0
    have h1 := h 1
    have h2 := h (-1)
    have hb : b = -a * (p + q) := by linear_combination (1 / 2) * h1 - (1 / 2) * h2
    have hc : c = a * p * q := by linear_combination h0
    subst hb hc
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e : (-a * (p + q)) ^ 2 - 4 * a * (a * p * q) = (a * (p - q)) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [e]
      exact sq_nonneg _
    · rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [mul_pos ha (sub_pos.2 hp), mul_pos ha (sub_pos.2 hq)]
    · have e := mul_pos ha (mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hp) (sub_pos.2 hq))
      nlinarith
  · rintro ⟨hD, hk, hf⟩
    obtain ⟨v, t, ht, hb, hc, hv⟩ : ∃ v t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ b = -2 * a * v ∧ c = a * (v ^ 2 - t ^ 2) ∧ v = -b / (2 * a) := by
      have hs2 := Real.sq_sqrt hD
      refine ⟨-b / (2 * a), |Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) / (2 * a)|, abs_nonneg _, by field_simp, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [sq_abs, div_pow, div_pow, hs2]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [← hv] at hk
    clear hv hD
    subst hb hc
    refine ⟨v - t, v + t, fun x => by ring, ?_, by linarith⟩
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have h1 := mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ t - (v - k)) (by linarith : 0 ≤ t + (v - k))
    have h2 := mul_nonneg ha.le h1
    nlinarith
